instructions.name: cancel_redemption
docs: Give back the unpaid part of a request and close it (owner only).
Reads no `Market` and needs no keeper, so it works when the market is
paused, the price is stale or the keeper is down. Returns the escrowed
L and S and all rent to the owner.

instructions.name: configure_market_advance
docs: Set a market's advance cap and lender (market.authority). Creates the
`MarketAdvance` PDA on first use. `max_advance_bps = 0` turns advances
off. The lender (the token account advances come from and are repaid
to) may change only while nothing is outstanding.

accounts.name: lender
docs: The token account advances come from and are repaid to.

instructions.name: receive_advance
docs: Take a liquidity advance into the collateral vault. `market.authority`
signs (`has_one`) and so does the `funder` who owns the lender account,
which is the GlobalClp PDA when the CLP's `advance_to_market` calls
this. The cash is NOT credited to `total_collateral`: CR and the
haircut never see it, and only `settle_redemption` and `repay_advance`
can spend it. Capped at `max_advance_bps` of `total_collateral`.

accounts.name: funder
docs: Owner of the lender account; the GlobalClp PDA signing through CPI.

instructions.name: repay_advance
docs: Repay the advance from the vault to its lender (market.authority or
keeper). Never more than is outstanding, and the vault keeps the
market's own liquid share (`redemption::repay_allowed`), so a repay can
only return the advance's own cash. The keeper calls it when the
market's own recall lands, before that cash is lent again.

accounts.name: signer
docs: market.authority or market.keeper_authority. Safe for the keeper: the
money can only go back to the recorded lender.

instructions.name: request_redemption
docs: Queue a paired redemption the vault cannot pay now. The L and S move
into escrow token accounts owned by the request PDA; the keeper pays
the request (in parts if need be) with `settle_redemption`, and the
owner can `cancel_redemption` the unpaid rest at any time. Same active,
Stress, price-freshness and $10-minimum checks as `redeem_paired`.

instructions.name: settle_redemption
docs: Pay the largest part of a request the vault's cash covers now (keeper
only), up to `max_l_amount` of L with the matching pro-rata S. Prices,
haircuts and charges fee + dev tax exactly like `redeem_paired`
(`redemption::quote_at_navs`), burns that part from escrow and pays the
owner. Unlike the instant path it may spend the treasury advance's cash
(that is what the advance is for), but never more than the vault holds.
When the request is fully paid and `owner` is passed, the escrows and
the request close and their rent goes back to the owner; without
`owner` an empty request waits for the owner's `cancel_redemption`.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The keeper. Same signer as `recall_collateral_from_yield`, so a recall
and the settle it pays for share one transaction.

accounts.name: owner_collateral
docs: Where the owner is paid: any cUSDC account the request owner owns.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The request owner, receiving the rent when the last part closes the
request. Optional so the settle still fits beside a large venue recall;
must equal `request.owner` when present.

types.name: MarketAdvance
docs: The treasury's reversible liquidity advance to one market (r58 lever 3).
PDA seeds: `[b"market_advance", market]`. The advance's cash sits in the
market's collateral vault but is NOT `total_collateral`: CR and the haircut
never count it, and every pre-existing outflow is gated on the market's own
liquid share, so only `settle_redemption` and `repay_advance` spend it.
Invariant: `vault + deployed_to_yield = total_collateral + outstanding + slack`.

fields.name: lender
docs: The only token account an advance may come from and be repaid to
(the CLP global vault). Changeable only while nothing is outstanding.

fields.name: max_advance_bps
docs: Cap: `outstanding ≤ max_advance_bps × total_collateral / 10_000`.
0 = advances off. r58's 2,500 (0.25×) is a TEST value, not a proposal.

types.name: RedemptionAmounts
docs: `request_redemption` arguments, in ONE struct (the v1.45 toolchain
miscompiles per-argument borsh offsets on multi-arg instructions).

types.name: RedemptionRequest
docs: A paired redemption waiting for the keeper to pay it (r58 lever 1 + 2).
PDA seeds: `[b"redemption", market, owner]` — one open request per
(market, owner). The escrowed L and S sit in two token accounts owned by
this PDA (`[b"redemption_escrow", request, mint]`); their balances always
equal `l_remaining` / `s_remaining`. The tokens stay in supply until a
settle burns them, so a waiting request changes no CR or haircut.
Lives in its own account, never in `Market` (Anchor deserializes before
realloc; see `market_space_tests`).

fields.name: gross_paid
docs: Running totals over all fills (cUSDC atoms).

fields.name: max_l_amount
docs: Most L to settle in this call (`u64::MAX` = all that fits). The
program shrinks it to what the vault's cash covers.
